clauses.quote: The Superintendent shall adopt regulations which will prescribe those criteria.

Students residing outside the city of Birmingham must obtain written permission from the Superintendent of their home district and the Superintendent of the Birmingham Board of Education to enroll in a Birmingham City School.
clauses.subject_text: Students residing outside the city of Birmingham

clauses.quote: These students must pay tuition according to the current rate structure established by the Birmingham City Board of Education.
In the case of an exceptional student, the school system from which the student is transferring will agree to pay tuition based on the actual cost of educating the exceptional student.
clauses.subject_text: the school system from which the student is transferring

clauses.quote: Students failing to pay the prescribed tuition charges will not be allowed to continue attending a Birmingham City School
clauses.subject_text: Students failing to pay the prescribed tuition charges

clauses.quote: Students failing to pay the prescribed tuition charges will not be awarded credit for courses taken.

clauses.quote: These charges must be paid one month in advance.

Students residing in the City of Birmingham, likewise, must obtain written permission from the Superintendent of the Birmingham City Schools, as well as permission from the Superintendent of the district to which transfer is sought, in order to enroll in a public school outside the Birmingham Public School System.
clauses.subject_text: Students residing in the City of Birmingham

clauses.quote: The transfer of a Birmingham student to another school system, or the transfer of a student from another school system to a school in the Birmingham School System, will not be approved if the transfer will adversely affect the efforts to integrate the Birmingham School from or to which the transfer is sought.
clauses.subject_text: The transfer of a Birmingham student to another school system, or the transfer of a student from another school system to a school in the Birmingham School System

clauses.quote: The Birmingham Board of Education shall operate a Child Nutrition program that meets the educational and nutritional needs of students.
